cacheToQuery.ttl_seconds: SELECT id, CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (close_date + CASE WHEN cb_service_name IN ('HOTELS_POSTPAY', 'HOTELS_POSTPAY_PREDICTOR') THEN INTERVAL '2 years' WHEN cb_service_name IN ('AVIA', 'CONCERT', 'SPECTACLE', 'EXHIBITION', 'MOVIE', 'SHOPPING_BANK') THEN INTERVAL '6 months' ELSE INTERVAL '1 month' END) - NOW()) AS INTEGER) AS ttl_seconds FROM public.offer;
cacheToQuery.targeting_type: SELECT id, targeting_type FROM public.offer where targeting_type = 'DYNAMIC'
